scope: Preserve captured symbolic-link identity, DONT_REPARSE behavior and named-object ownership while representing a fixed current-session BaseNamedObjects alias to an independently selected directory. No arbitrary host path traversal or blanket type acceptance.

assumptions.assumption: An opened selected alias directory may be identical to another fixed selected directory despite its parent entry being a SymbolicLink.
assumptions.basis: Exact CI trace; native directory aliases are possible, but actual target remains unknown.
assumptions.dependent-result: Use native object identity, rather than a guessed target string, to bind the alias.
assumptions.stress-test: Same object, distinct object, missing metadata, type/name mismatch, DONT_REPARSE, reparse budget, canonical named-object identity and rights.
assumptions.falsification-probe: NtCompareObjects does not establish selected target identity, or actual CI alias resolves outside the fixed target profile.
